decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions and disrupting their game plan using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. It relies on spells like Snuff Out and Chainer's Edict to deal with the opponent's threats, while cards like Thought Scour and Deep Analysis help maintain card advantage. The deck also includes creatures like Augur of Bolas and Gurmag Angler for additional threats and board presence. The mana base consists mainly of Islands, with Ice Tunnel and Contaminated Aquifer providing additional utility.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By utilizing cards like Counterspell, Agony Warp, and Chainer's Edict, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while staying ahead in card advantage with spells like Deep Analysis and Thought Scour. The deck also features efficient threats like Gurmag Angler and Tolarian Terror to close out the game once the opponent has been sufficiently controlled. The main win condition is to outvalue the opponent and grind them down over time.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards that provide value over time, such as Archaeomancer and Mulldrifter. The deck also aims to gain incremental advantage through the use of Ephemerate to repeatedly blink key creatures and spells. By generating card advantage with draw spells like Deep Analysis and Snap, as well as countering opponent's threats with cards like Prohibit and Counterspell, the deck can out-value and outlast the opponent in a long game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting its spells.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through the use of Ephemerate to repeatedly trigger enters-the-battlefield effects of creatures like Mulldrifter and Llanowar Visionary. The deck also utilizes mana ramping cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl to accelerate and help cast higher cost spells. Abundant Growth helps with fixing mana and drawing cards, while Goliath Paladin and Jewel Thief provide additional win conditions. Soul of Migration can be used for protection and Late to Dinner helps with gaining life and bringing back key creatures.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to maintain control of the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while quickly deploying evasive threats like Delver of Secrets and Tolarian Terror. By utilizing a mix of counterspells, card draw, and disruptive spells like Echoing Truth and Shore Up, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and cheap interaction. This deck sacrifices some late-game power for a fast and aggressive early game, aiming to win quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to control the opponent's actions and resources through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The gates in the deck provide additional mana fixing and synergy with cards like Citadel Gate and Basilisk Gate. The deck aims to maintain board control and card advantage while slowly wearing down the opponent's resources. By constantly disrupting the opponent's strategy and maintaining a strong defensive position, this deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly cycle through your library to fill up your graveyard with creatures, then cast ritual spells and use combo cards like Reaping the Graves and Songs of the Damned to bring them back for explosive plays. The deck aims to generate a large amount of mana to cast multiple spells in one turn, allowing you to overwhelm your opponent with a swarm of creatures. With proper timing and sequencing of spells, this combo deck can create a powerful board presence and win the game in a single turn.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by removing threats, gaining card advantage, and disrupting the opponent's game plan. It utilizes a combination of removal spells, sacrifice effects, and bounce creatures to maintain board control. The deck also includes mana fixing and card draw to ensure consistency and resilience. By efficiently removing threats and out-valuing the opponent, this control deck aims to slowly grind out a victory while keeping the opponent off balance.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing the Urzatron lands to ramp up mana quickly and stabilize the board with defensive spells and creatures. By casting powerful card draw spells, such as Mulldrifter and Compulsive Research, and repeatedly blinking important creatures like Stonehorn Dignitary with Ephemerate and Ghostly Flicker, the deck aims to lock down the opponent's ability to attack and win the game through attrition and card advantage. The key is to efficiently use the Urzatron lands and synergy between cards to establish dominance and control the pace of the game.

This deck focuses on playing cheap artifacts to swarm the board and then sacrifice them for various effects, such as dealing damage or drawing cards. It also includes countermagic to protect key threats and disrupt opponent's plans. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with an aggressive game plan fueled by the synergy of artifacts and efficient removal options.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the affinity mechanic to quickly drop powerful artifact creatures and overwhelm the opponent with efficient attacks. The deck includes cards that help to generate extra artifacts, such as Ichor Wellspring and Chromatic Star, while also packing removal and burn spells like Galvanic Blast to control the board. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure with aggressive plays, while also having the option to draw cards and answer threats with cards like Thoughtcast and Metallic Rebuke.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of creature removal, counterspells, and protection spells. The Gates archetype provides mana fixing and card draw, allowing for a consistent and powerful control strategy. Guardian of the Guildpact serves as a strong defensive creature, while Sacred Cat and Squadron Hawk provide early game threats. Brainstorm and Counterspell help to control the board, while cards like Prismatic Strands and Gift of Orzhova offer protection and added value. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through careful resource management and strategic plays.

The main theme of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure with cheap, efficient creatures and targeted removal spells. The deck utilizes hand disruption, creature removal, and life drain effects to grind down the opponent's resources and finish them off with big swings from Gray Merchant of Asphodel. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Sign in Blood and Phyrexian Rager to keep the pressure on and ensure a steady stream of threats.

The deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost creatures like Festival Crasher, Kiln Fiend, and Monastery Swiftspear to deal damage to the opponent. By combining these creatures with instant spells like Crash Through, Lightning Bolt, and Mutagenic Growth, the deck aims to pump up their power and speed to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Faithless Looting and Manamorphose help to maintain card advantage and keep the aggression going. The goal is to play aggressively and efficiently to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly playing artifact creatures and utilizing cards like Thoughtcast to draw more cards to maintain momentum. It also uses burn spells like Galvanic Blast for direct damage and removal, as well as sacrificing artifacts for value with cards like Deadly Dispute. The mana base is artifact-focused and includes land destruction to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Essentially, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy fueled by artifacts and synergy within the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly flood the board with cheap artifact creatures and use them to attack the opponent aggressively. The deck utilizes a combination of low-cost artifacts, card draw, and removal spells to maintain tempo and overwhelm the opponent. By efficiently deploying threats and leveraging the affinity mechanic to reduce costs, the deck can quickly build a formidable board presence and deal significant damage to the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of sacrifice outlets and graveyard recursion provides additional versatility and potential for burst damage.
